[[File:All-Out Brothers.png|thumb|250px|Phil (left) and Mayshure (right)]] '''Phil''' (Japanese: '''ゼン''' ''Zen'') and '''Mayshure''' (Japanese: '''リョク''' ''Ryoku''), collectively referred to as the '''All-Out Brothers''' (Japanese: '''ゼンリョク兄弟''' ''Zenryoku Brothers''), are [[Character of the day|characters of the day]] who appeared in ''[[JN076|All Out, All of the Time!]]''. They signed up for the [[Pokémon Catch Adventure Race]] race and met {{Ash}} and [[Goh]]. Recognizing Ash as [[Alola]]'s first ever {{pkmn|Champion}}, they posed for pictures with Ash before taking part in the race. During the race, they rode together on Phil's {{p|Kommo-o}} and came across a boulder blocking the path. They attempted to have Kommo-o use {{m|Clangorous Soulblaze}} on the boulder but the move failed, causing it to start rolling down the path before being stopped by [[Goh's Boldore]]. Later, they came across a lake where they had to catch themselves a {{p|Bruxish}}, which they attempted to do with another Clangorous Soulblaze, which failed. They later met up with Ash and Goh as they attempted to catch a {{p|Passimian}} but their efforts were stopped by {{TRT}} who caught the Passimian, {{TP|Goh|Grookey}}, and {{AP|Pikachu}}. Phil and Mayshure were able to pull off a Clangorous Soulblaze and sent Team Rocket blasting off. After catching a Passimian, they raced to the finish line, only to come second behind Ash and Goh and received a runner up prize. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} This listing is of the All-Out Brothers' known Pokémon: ====Phil==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Phil |pkmn=Kommo-o |type1=Dragon |type2=Fighting |img=Phil Kommo-o.png |epnum=JN076 |epname=All Out, All of the Time! |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Kommo-o}} is Phil's only known Pokémon. Although both Trainers command Kommo-o, Phil owns its {{i|Poké Ball}}. The All-Out Brothers rode on Kommo-o during the [[Pokémon Catch Adventure Race]], where it attempted to use {{m|Clangorous Soulblaze}} to deal with a boulder and {{p|Bruxish}}, only to fail. Kommo-o succeeded in using Clangorous Soulblaze to deal with {{TRT}}, sending them blasting off. Kommo-o's only known move is {{m|Clanging Scales}}{{tt|*|Never used, confirmed through the use of its exclusive Z-Move}}.
